description: Point-in-time restore drill: restore a production PostgreSQL database to a specific timestamp (T-2 hours) into an isolated environment, verify the restored data matches expected state, run application tests against the restored DB, and then clean up the isolated environment. Must: identify restore point, run PITR restore to isolated environment, verify row counts and critical records, test application compatibility, and securely delete the restored data. Risk factors: WAL archive gaps, restore to non-isolated environment causing data corruption, verification missing corrupted rows. Tools available: aws RDS, wal-g, psql, terraform.
